method: Browse-derived: ASF LATLON browse (HH/HV/HH composite, R==B verified, R~HHHH r=0.86, G~HVHV r=0.85), full-frame percentile harmonisation, ensemble of 12 settings (3 thresholds x 2 median windows x 2 MMU). Robust = change in all 12, fringe = change in some. Calibrated GCOV float processing is gated on an Earthdata login (h5 returns 401).

browseGrid.note: Areas are computed on the ~50 m browse grid, not the 20 m native GCOV grid.

qaFlags: 2026-09-07 HVHV browse is black over the whole AOI (mean 1.0) - defective render, HV excluded for that date; HH unaffected.
40 MHz dates (2026-07-21, 2026-08-14) render with different texture - used in the series, never as a change-pair anchor.
One top cluster was rejected: nodata-black in July, data in October (coverage artefact at the AOI edge).
Stable-land control patch (east farmland) varies 116-138 intensity across the 9 dates after harmonisation.
